definitions: to hit forcibly and deliberately with one's hand or a weapon
to refuse to work as a form of organized protest
to occur to or be perceived by the mind
to ignite a match by rubbing it against a rough surface
to reach or achieve a position or agreement
examples: He managed to strike the ball.
Workers decided to strike for better pay.
A thought began to strike her.
Strike a match to light the candle.
They finally managed to strike a deal.
